text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A: chunk-then-encrypt. Plaintext split into 256 KiB chunks (UnixFS default); each chunk sealed with the object's random content key (AES-128-GCM), nonce = chunk index (safe because the key is unique per object), AAD = label || chunk index || total chunk count || final flag (detects reorder, drop, truncation); each encrypted chunk is a raw block with its own CID arranged as a standard IPFS DAG (CAR-movable); the ordered chunk-CID manifest is carried inside the encrypted Message attachment object; resumable, partial and multi-relay parallel fetch. No convergent encryption (no cross-user dedup).
